== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The void is a vast, dark realm that serves as the home of the [[Great Elders]]. It is characterized by an endless expanse of [[Shadow{{!}}shadow]] containing distant, vibrating spots of color that resemble stars. While some ancient scholars theorized that this dimension connects different worlds, its primary known function is as a medium for the [[Great Elders]] to travel between planets and communicate with one another. The [[Elders]] use rifts or [[cracks in the sky]] as conduits to move to and from this space, sometimes attempting to use these openings to ascend beyond the current world. The void is associated with profound sensations of [[hunger]], icy cold, and an overwhelming sense of [[Shadow{{!}}shadow]] that can consume life. It is also described as a place where the [[Elders]] may encounter other entities or face conflict with their own kind.}}

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The void manifests as a realm of darkness capable of swallowing all awareness. It is visible to those below through various holes in the reality of the sky. Messengers have utilized this space to carry [[Jerri]] toward the [[Capital]], where she eventually found support for her feet upon a stone. During their journey, [[Calder]] and Ozriel were also observed drifting together within the expanse.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Messengers carried [[Jerri]] through their void to the [[Capital]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c2">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 2</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The void is a place of darkness that can swallow awareness.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c9">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 9</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Calder]] and Ozriel drift together in the void.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c11">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 11</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The void is a place where [[Jerri]]'s feet were supported by a stone.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c20">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 20</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The void is visible through the holes in reality in the sky.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c22">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 22</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>
